title: Power Grid Maintenance
summary: Given c power stations with unique identifiers from 1 to c, and n bidirectional cables connecting them, handle queries to either check or offline stations.
statement: Given c power stations with unique identifiers from 1 to c, and n bidirectional cables connecting them, handle queries to either check or offline stations. For a check query [1, x], if station x is online, it resolves the check itself. If station x is offline, the check is resolved by the operational station with the smallest id in the same power grid as x, or the query returns -1 if no such station exists. For an offline query [2, x], station x goes offline (non-operational). Maintain the power grid's structure without altering its connectivity.
constraints: Stations are numbered one through c and initially online.
Offline stations remain in their original connected component.
A check uses itself when online, otherwise the smallest online station in its component or -1.
hints: Connectivity never changes, so components can be built once.
Give each component a min-heap and lazily discard offline heap tops.
Answer online x directly; otherwise clean and read its component heap.
Union-find fixes membership and lazy deletion always exposes the smallest remaining online ID.
editorial: Union-find fixes membership and lazy deletion always exposes the smallest remaining online ID.

tests.explanation: The three checks are resolved by stations three, two, and three.
The isolated station first answers itself, then has no online replacement.
